hashtag-generator.name: Hashtag Generator

hashtag-generator.article:
How does the Hashtag Generator work?

The Hashtag Generator helps you discover the best tags for your posts. Using the right keywords is essential to increase organic reach.

Step-by-step how to use:

  1. Choose the main category of your post from the available options on the screen (e.g., Fashion, Food, Fitness).
  2. The tool will process and instantly display a cloud with the most engaging hashtags for that niche.
  3. Click the 'Copy All' button at the bottom of the results box.
  4. Paste them at the end of your Instagram, TikTok, or Twitter caption, and you're done!

Advantages

Don't overdo it! Although Instagram allows up to 30 hashtags, experts recommend using between 5 to 15 hyper-relevant hashtags for better engagement.

  2. Fill in the main field with your website link, desired text, or WiFi network data.
  3. Adjust the code and background colors using the color pickers to match your brand.
  4. The code will be generated automatically on the screen in real-time.
  5. Click the Download buttons to save the image in high-quality PNG or SVG format.

  • 100% Offline: Codes are generated directly in your browser, with no data sent over the network.

features.interface: Upload your PDF by dragging it into the tool. Instantly see the original size, optimized size, page count, and compression percentage in a clean, visual results panel.

faq.q: Why is my PDF only slightly smaller after compression?
faq.a: Client-side PDF compression focuses on removing metadata and optimizing file structure. If your PDF consists mainly of high-resolution embedded images, the reduction will be minimal since image recompression requires server-side processing.

faq.q: Does compression affect PDF quality?
faq.a: No. Our tool optimizes the file structure without altering the visual content. Text, images, and formatting remain exactly the same — only unnecessary hidden data is removed.

faq.q: What's the maximum file size I can compress?
faq.a: The tool supports PDF files up to 50MB. Since processing happens in your browser, very large files may take longer on devices with limited memory.

faq.q: Can I compress password-protected PDFs?
faq.a: Unfortunately, encrypted or password-protected PDFs cannot be processed by our client-side tool. You'll need to remove the password protection before compressing.

faq.q: How long should my password be?
faq.a: We recommend at least 16 characters for important accounts. Passwords with 20+ characters using all character types (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols) provide the strongest protection against brute-force attacks.

faq.q: Are the generated passwords truly random?
faq.a: Yes. We use the Web Crypto API (crypto.getRandomValues), which provides cryptographically secure pseudo-random numbers. This is the same level of randomness used in encryption protocols.

faq.q: Should I use the same password for multiple sites?
faq.a: Absolutely not. Each online account should have its own unique password. If one site is breached, reused passwords put all your other accounts at risk. Use our generator to create a unique password for every account.

faq.q: Where should I store my generated passwords?
faq.a: We recommend using a reputable password manager (like Bitwarden, 1Password, or KeePass) to securely store all your passwords. Never write passwords on sticky notes or store them in plain text files.

How does the Pomodoro Timer help?

The Pomodoro Timer uses the famous technique of focusing intensely for a period (usually 25 minutes) and resting for a short time (5 minutes) to avoid mental burnout and increase productivity in studies and work.

Step-by-step how to use:

  1. Click the large 'Start' button on the screen to begin the 25-minute focus session.
  2. Work intensely on your task without distractions until the counter reaches zero.
  3. When the alarm rings, the tab will automatically change to 'Short Break' (5 minutes).
  4. Use this time to stretch, drink water, and rest your mind.
  5. After 4 complete focus cycles, allow yourself a 'Long Break' of 15 minutes (selectable in the top menu).

Whether during Black Friday, e-commerce promotions, or closing a deal, knowing how to accurately calculate discounts can represent real savings.

Step-by-step how to use:

  1. In the 'Original Price' field, enter the full price of the product before the discount (e.g., 250).
  2. In the '% Discount' field, enter the percentage to be discounted (e.g., 30 for 30%).
  3. The results will be displayed instantly: the discount amount and the final price to pay.
  4. Use the reverse mode 'Calculate Percentage' to find out what the discount percentage was when comparing two prices.

Doing percentage calculations in your head is error-prone. Our calculator ensures instant accuracy, preventing you from paying more than you should or selling below your desired profit margin. Ideal for comparing prices between stores and detecting fake discounts.

faq.q: When should I use Base64 encoding?
faq.a: Common use cases include embedding small images in HTML/CSS (data URIs), encoding authentication tokens for API headers, transmitting binary data in JSON payloads, and encoding file attachments for email protocols.
